$schema.description:
Optional: the JSON Schema this file follows, so editors can check
it as you type (`"$schema": "../schema/items.schema.json"`).

CellType.description: What makes an item type a power cell: how much it holds when full.

capacity_kj.description:
How much energy it holds when full, in kilojoules (1 to
[`MAX_CELL_KJ`]).

cell.description: If it's a power cell, how much it holds (decision D59).

glyph.description: The character the map draws it with, lying on the floor.

id.description: How maps refer to it, like `"basic_laser_cutter"`.

light.description:
How many tiles its light reaches, if it gives light (like a hand
lamp), from 1 to 20: around it where it lies, or around you when
you carry it. Optional: it gives no light. With `power`, only while
it's switched on and its cell isn't flat.

material.description: The id of the material it's made of, unless a map says otherwise.

name.description: How it's shown to the player, like "basic laser cutter".

power.description: If it runs on a power cell, what it draws and which cell it takes.

qualities.description: The tool qualities it has, like `{ "LASER": 1 }`.

solid_percent.description: How much of its volume is solid material, in percent (1 to 100).

volume_ml.description: How much room it takes up, in millilitres.

wear.description: If it can be worn, what wearing it gives.

PocketType.description:
One pocket of a wearable item, as content: its name and how much it
holds.

max_mass_g.description: How much weight it holds, in grams.

Power.description: What makes an item type run on a cell.

cell.description: The id of the cell item it takes.

watts.description: What it draws while it works, in watts (joules a second; at least 1).

Wear.description: What wearing an item gives you. For now, just its pockets.
